verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS CRM platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only the Dataverse Web API (HTTP requests, batch, SQL/FetchXML queries) and Power Apps, never a command-line tool. A REST API is a developer building block, not an official CLI, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
